title: Too Small.
text: Too Small.. I returned this after purchasing it for a wicker chair. The cushion is smaller than advertised and the color wasn't the same as in the picture, I guess it would be okay for a dining room chair, but not much else. The quality is also questionable.

description: This 16-inch by 17-inch four tack chairpad is both beautiful and functional. This cushion offers both comfort and easy care. Designed in a specially treated cotton fabric that repels liquids to avoid stains. This chairpad features a non-slip latex backing to grip chairs securely, as well as Delight Fill, a unique polyester filling for ultra-soft and long lasting seating.
